title: Henrix PRO 40CE 40
desc:
The Henrix PRO 40CE is a feature-rich 40-inch cutaway electro-acoustic guitar that elevates the experience of beginner and intermediate players. It offers upgrades over the Henrix 40C model, with enhanced sound quality, a durable build, and added electronics. The guitar includes a dual-action truss rod, die-cast tuners, and ABS binding—components typically found in premium models, now offered at an accessible price.

The dual-action truss rod allows users to adjust neck bow in both directions, helping maintain low, comfortable string action. This design extends the guitar’s longevity, making it more resistant to humidity and seasonal changes. Traditional single truss rods require extensive repairs for neck warps, but the 40CE avoids such issues.

Equipped with 18:1 die-cast tuning machines, the guitar offers precise tuning stability for long jam sessions. The ABS edge binding not only adds visual flair but also protects the body against impact and moisture—key for preserving the instrument over time.

The EQ-7545R preamp system features a 4-band EQ (Bass, Mid, Treble, Presence), volume control, and a low-battery LED. Paired with a piezo ceramic pickup, it allows for clean amplification. Accessories include a gigbag, picks, strings, strap, string winder, and polishing cloth.

Taylor 312ce-N Grand Concert Nylon String Electro Acoustic Guitars With Bag- Natural Overview: Our nylon-string Grand Concert 312ce-N balances sapele’s bright and focused tone with the naturally mellow flavors of the nylon sound This makes a great choice for players who favor the comfort of a small-body acoustic and crave modern steel-string features like a cutaway and an onboard pickup on a nylon-string guitar.

Features: Grand Concert Body Length: 19 1/2" / Body Width: 15" / Body Depth: 4 3/8" Clarity and balance reign in this small, comfortable body shape The smaller body and tapered waist make it the ultimate studio and stage guitar Features a short scale and lighter string tension making it easier to play The small-body Grand Concert debuted in 1984 to meet the needs of a new wave of adventurous acoustic fingerstyle players In contrast to the traditionally darker, boomier voices of bigger body styles like dreadnoughts and jumbos, the GC’s compact size and tapered waist kept the overtones in check.

It was also more comfortable to play while sitting down, and the guitar’s slightly wider neck gave players more room for complex fingerings The GC’s smaller sonic footprint also fit cleanly in a mix with other instruments when tracking in the studio and with a band on stage, making it a useful tool for professional session and side players.

Our current generation of GC models continues to accommodate fingerstylists with finger-friendly traits like a shorter 24 7/8-inch scale length, which makes fretting easier and adds a slightly slinkier feel on the strings due to the lighter string tension If you feel more comfortable with a small body or favor controlled overtones, a Grand Concert is a great option.

The smallest of Taylor’s full-size body shapes Its compact dimensions make for a physically comfortable guitar with an intimate feel and sound.

The smaller footprint keeps the overtones in check, contributing to a focused, articulate sound that’s well-suited for recording and stage work Sitka Spruce As a guitar soundboard, or top, Sitka spruce is the tonewood standard of the modern era.

It’s used on 85-90 percent of the guitars that Taylor makes Its combination of strength and elasticity translates into a broad dynamic range, yielding crisp articulation and allowing for everything from aggressive strumming and flatpicking to fingerpicking.

Sitka spruce is Bob Taylor’s personal favorite for an all-around great guitar Sapele An alternative tonewood that joined the Taylor fold over a decade ago.

It’s sometimes mistakenly referred to as African mahogany because it closely resembles the West African wood khaya, which is commercially known as African mahogany Sapele is a highly sustainable, relatively fast-growing wood.

Tonally, it does everything that mahogany does, with a little extra treble zing We’ll be able to offer it for a long, long time.

title: Tyma TFC-28 OM Cutaway Electro Acoustic Guitar
desc:
The Tyma TFC-28 is the crown jewel of the "28 Replica Series," a line of instruments dedicated to recreating the legendary acoustic sounds of the 20th century. title: Tyma TJ45 Red Label Series Jumbo Electro Acoustic Guitar
desc:
The Tyma TJ45 is a standout model from the prestigious "Red Label" Series, representing the perfect harmony between rigorous acoustic science and traditional lutherie. Unlike standard mass-produced instruments, the TJ45 is born from Tyma's advanced Acoustic Laboratory, where computer simulation technology is used to predict and optimize the guitar's voice before a single piece of wood is cut.

This data-driven design is then brought to life by master luthiers who hand-tune every component. The result is a Jumbo-bodied instrument that offers a massive, full-bodied sound with a unique personality— perfect for players who demand power, presence, and precision.

title: Tyma TD-28V Replica Series Dreadnought Electro Acoustic Guitar
desc:
The Tyma TD-28V is a masterclass in vintage reverence and modern acoustic engineering. Part of Tyma's acclaimed "28 Replica Series," this All-Solid Dreadnought is built to capture the soul of the most iconic steel-string guitars in history.

Unlike standard production models, the TD-28V features a Handmade-Grade selection of naturally aged tonewoods. The Solid Sitka Spruce top has been naturally aged for over 5 years, while the Solid East Indian Rosewood back and sides have been aged for over 6 years. This extensive aging process, combined with Tyma’s proprietary Double V-Bracing and thermal treatment, ensures that the guitar sounds "broken-in" and mature from the very first strum.

With its commanding Dreadnought body, the TD-28V is a "cannon" of a guitar—offering the deep, piano- like bass and bell-like highs that bluegrass, country, and rock players have coveted for decades.

The Spruce top provides sparkling highs, deep lows, and a wide dynamic range, while the Striped Ebony back and sides add clarity and a unique visual flair. Whether you are strumming hard or fingerpicking softly, the A2 responds with precision.

It also features the TYMA x DOUBLE OS1 Smart Pickup, ensuring that your acoustic tone is amplified with digital precision and clarity.

title: Tyma Star Sea Custom Series All-Solid Grand Auditorium Electro Acoustic Guitar
desc:
Unlock a Universe of Sound with the Tyma Star Sea.

The Tyma Star Sea is a masterpiece from the Tyma Custom Collaboration Series, representing a fusion of precision engineering and artisanal craftsmanship. Originally designed as a limited custom run, this handmade-grade instrument offers an "all-solid" wood construction usually reserved for boutique guitars at a much higher price point.

Whether you are a fingerstyle virtuoso or a dynamic strummer, the Star Sea is engineered to help you explore the "sea of stars" of acoustic aesthetics.

title: Tyma TG-15 Grand Auditorium Electro Acoustic Guitar
desc:
The Tyma TG15 is designed for the player who demands the rich, complex sound that only an all-solid instrument can provide. As the Grand Auditorium model of the prestigious 15 Series, it strikes the perfect balance between comfort and power.

At its heart is a 3A-Grade Solid Sitka Spruce top, hand selected for its tight grain and superior resonance. This is paired with Solid Mahogany back and sides, creating a classic tonal foundation that is warm,

punchy, and incredibly articulate. Whether you are recording in the studio or performing on stage, the all- solid construction ensures unmatched sustain and a tone that matures and improves the more you play it.

Under the hood, the TG15 utilizes Tyma’s proprietary Double V-Bracing. This advanced internalarchitecture allows the top to vibrate more freely than traditional X-bracing, resulting in a wider dynamic range and a more "open" sound right out of the case.

title: Tyma HG-60E 6 String Electro Acoustic Guitar
desc: The Tyma HG-60E is a versatile Grand Auditorium acoustic guitar designed for players who seek a balanced, professional sound with a modern aesthetic. Built with a Sitka Spruce top and Sapele back and sides, it delivers a bright, clear tone with a warm, woody midrange. The Grand Auditorium body and satin finish provide a omfortable playing experience, while the dove tail neck joint ensures stable energy transfer for enhanced resonance. Featuring durable Tech Ebony components and sleek black diecast tuners, the HG-60E is an excellent choice for both practicing at home and performing on stage.

title: Tyma TG-12 Grand Auditorium Electro Acoustic Guitar
desc:
The Tyma TG12 is a sophisticated instrument designed for the player who appreciates vintage aesthetics but demands modern performance. As the Grand Auditorium model of the 12 Series, it offers a versatile, balanced voice that is perfect for everything from delicate fingerstyle to robust strumming.

This model features a Solid Engelmann Spruce top (or Solid Sitka Spruce, depending on the specific run), known for its complex overtones and responsiveness to a light touch. This is paired with Rosewood back and sides, delivering the deep, scooping lows and sparkling highs that have defined the sound of acoustic music for generations.

What sets the TG12 apart is its internal architecture. It utilizes Tyma’s advanced Double V-Bracing, a feature typically found on their flagship all-solid models. This allows the solid top to vibrate more freely, resulting in superior volume and sustain compared to standard X-braced guitars. Externally, it is dressed to impress with vintage-style Herringbone binding and Nickel Open-Back tuners.

title: Furch Green Gc-TR a 6 String Electro Acoustic Guitar
desc: The Green Performance TR a is designed for discerning players who prioritize stage performance, maximum playing comfort, and the most natural amplified tone. The soundboard of the guitar is made of carefully selected aged Sitka spruce that undergoes our proprietary torrefaction process, enhancing tonal maturity by increasing responsiveness, expanding dynamic range, and adding a warmer, more open character, while also giving the instrument a subtly darker, vintage-inspired appearance. These tonal qualities are further supported by our innovative individual soundboard voicing process. The back and sides are crafted from Indian rosewood, a tonewood known for its rich overtones, clear articulation, and deep, well-defined bass response. Together, these materials produce a harmonically complex, balanced sound with strong projection, excellent sustain, sparkling highs, articulate mids, and full, resonant lows, making the instrument particularly well-suited for expressive strumming, dynamic flatpicking, and articulate fingerstyle playing. To ensure outstanding performance on stage, the guitar is equipped with the LR Baggs Stagepro Element system, delivering a highly natural, studio-quality amplified sound that faithfully captures the instrument’s acoustic character.

title: Tyma TG-2 Acoustic Guitar with T-200 Max EQ
desc:
The Tyma TG-2 represents the perfect step up for the serious student or performing musician. This is a Solid Top instrument, meaning the soundboard is crafted from a single piece of wood rather than laminates, allowing it to vibrate more freely and sound better with age.

It features a Solid Sitka Spruce top, the industry standard for clarity and dynamic range, paired with Sapele back and sides for warmth and balance. The Grand Auditorium (GA) body shape is the ultimate all-rounder—comfortable enough for playing on the couch, yet powerful enough for the stage.

Finished in a smooth Satin (Matte), the TG-2 has an organic, woody feel that is fast on the neck and free from the sticky friction of gloss finishes. With durable Tech Ebony components and a Sapele rosette, it is built to look as good as it sounds.
